source.title: ETOPO 2022 15 Arc-Second Global Relief Model — 60 arc-second Bedrock elevation distribution
source.transform: Select centered every-30th latitude/longitude cell through a DAP2 hyperslab, yielding a 360 × 720 half-degree global bedrock grid; round elevations to signed 16-bit integer meters and base64-encode for the browser.

interpretation.classification: study constrained source; model-derived compact preprocessing
interpretation.caveat: ETOPO 2022 is a modern bedrock baseline, not a direct reconstruction of 777 ka topography. Earth 777 applies simulated paleo sea level separately and will add time-varying ice/isostasy/shoreline corrections in later phases.
